name: AMPLITECH GROUP INC. COM
description: AmpliTech Group Inc designs, develops, engineers, and assembles micro-wave component-based amplifiers that meet individual customer specifications. It operates in two segments: the manufacturing and engineering segment. The products of the company consist of RF amplifiers & related subsystems, operating at multiple frequencies from 50kHz to 44GHz, including Low Noise Amplifiers, Medium Power Amplifiers, cryogenic amplifiers, and custom assemblies. The company also offers non-recurring engineering services on a project-by-project basis, for a predetermined fixed contractual amount, or on a time-plus-material basis. It also operates as a manufacturer, & distributor of cryogenic microwave amplifiers, RF designs, & applications for Wireless Networks & the future of Wireless Communication.
